ClickHouse.//: Supplied at runtime via the ClickHouse__ConnectionString environment variable. Never commit a credential.

Postgres.//: Supplied at runtime via Postgres__ConnectionString. Never commit a credential.

ImportStorage.//: Must be outside the web root. Uploaded originals are never served directly.

Risk.//: Cut at a review capacity of about 500 entities per list on the clean reference window 2026-06-02..07-01 (all-time rules: on run 1790938349551). The curves and the cut are in docs/adr/ADR-014-risk-signals.md. A value is out of line when it is MORE than its threshold.

OperatorBands.//: The LTE and NR band numbers the operator's network uses (3 for LTE band 3, 78 for n78). Empty until the operator supplies them: the band view then shows every band's population and says the match is not configured. Set as OperatorBands__Lte__0=3, OperatorBands__Lte__1=... docs/architecture/19-network-planning.md.

CampaignExport.//: A campaign list of more than ApprovalThreshold numbers needs a second person's approval; 0 sends every list to one (the product owner's decision of 2026-10-21; the value is theirs to set). An approved list can be downloaded for ValidHours. docs/architecture/19-network-planning.md section 4.
